title: REVIEW_REQUIRED creates durable work without creating decision authority
summary: A sealed SecurityReviewReferralPolicy can map an exact Security assessment to a Relationship Case. The bridge attaches subject, assessment and policy references, but never manufactures DECISION or ACCOUNT_CONTROL authority.
invariants: Referral is idempotent for the exact Security assessment.
Relationship Case owns review workflow; downstream business authority owns any eventual mutation.
An ALLOW action can produce NO_REFERRAL.

provenance.claim: Review referral documentation defines the exact non-authoritative Relationship Case hand-off.
